verdict.rationale: Make is a SaaS automation platform. Whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an open-source license or a public source repository for the product; the docs cover only its API, MCP server, webhooks and a TypeScript SDK, with no licensing details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
